author: Deezi
body:
Welp...

IGN: Deezi

Reason: Banned for "Hacking-Aimbot" July 8, 2015

Why I should be unbanned: Well I wasn't hacking, I have past experiences with this false ban, because I was banned before for hacking though, I wasn't hacking, like this time.

Second time this happens, And I know I won't hack ever.

I was banned in CTH, There is this annoying fast-hit glitch that I always have so it isn't easy to see someone hacking there because it can be confused with that glitch.

I also want the proof about my "hacks". I know staff should have one.

This will take time for a response, I know that.

Well, *waiting*

- Deezi
